# Genc Krasniqi — Elite Personal Training in Dubai

> Premium in-home personal training, virtual coaching, recovery, sports massage, and football coaching in Dubai, UAE.

## About Genc Krasniqi

Genc Krasniqi is a former Swiss professional footballer (Grasshoppers Club Zürich, FC Rapperswil-Jona). He delivers bespoke fitness and health services directly to clients' homes across Dubai, specializing in high-net-worth individuals and expats.

## Services

- **Personal Training**: Bespoke in-home sessions combining workouts, recovery, and sports massage — all in one visit. No gym required.
- **Virtual Training**: Live 1-on-1 training over video with real-time form correction, personal programming, and the same intensity as an in-person session.
- **Recovery & Mobility**: Swiss-certified recovery work that releases blockages, restores mobility, and builds long-term resilience — delivered at your home.
- **Sports Massage**: Deep-tissue sports massage that releases tension, accelerates recovery, and prepares your body for what's next.
- **Football Coaching**: Professional football coaching by a former Swiss pro — tactics, speed, ball control, and game sharpening.
